summary.text: Mary Allen is the Democratic nominee for Indiana's 8th Congressional District. She is an Evansville small business owner, Army Reserve veteran and at-large member and vice president of the Evansville City Council, running on affordability, health care and accountability.

paragraphs.text: Lives in Evansville, Indiana. She says she grew up in a working-class family, with a father who was a Teamster and truck driver, and has lived in Indiana for a little over 30 years with her husband, Greg.
Served in the U.S. Army Reserve.

In a WNIN interview, she said she worked in health care for 15 years and alongside her husband in a nonprofit ministry for almost a decade, and has owned small businesses for 15 years, most recently a retail store on Main Street in Evansville. Ballotpedia lists her as owner of Sixth and Zero and affiliated with Virginia Street Properties.
At-large member of the Evansville City Council, where she has also served as council vice president; she describes herself as a Rotary member.
Has served on the Vanderburgh County Solid Waste Board and the Evansville Metropolitan Planning Organization, and chaired the Enterprise Zone.
Won the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary with 66.7% of the vote over three candidates; she was endorsed by the district Democratic party, according to WNIN.
Describes herself as a mother and grandmother of two.

sources.title: Trio of Dems vie for Indiana US House seat in primary; one candidate exits race
Four Democrats compete for the chance to challenge Rep. Mark Messmer in Indiana's 8th Congressional District
